welcome_subtitle: Give your AI coding agent a personality
known_mbti_prompt: Do you already know your MBTI type?
known_mbti_quiz: No, take me through the quiz
invalid_mbti: Invalid MBTI type. Please enter a valid 4-letter type (e.g. INTJ, ENFP).
quiz_intro: 10 quick questions — 5 about you, 5 about your ideal agent style.
your_mbti_result: Based on your answers, your personality type is: {type}
no_tools_selected: No tools selected. Please select at least one.
done_message: Your AI agent is now a {type} ({name}).

questions.text: After a long, draining day — how do you recover?
choices: Alone time: reading, gaming, or just being quiet
Catching up with a friend or talking it out

questions.text: When starting a new project, your first instinct is to...
choices: Think about the big picture and long-term vision
Map out the concrete steps and immediate requirements

questions.text: A close friend asks for advice on a tough decision. You...
choices: Analyze the situation logically and give them the most rational path
Make sure they feel heard first, then offer perspective
Planned: clear agenda, scheduled blocks, predictable structure
Flexible: I adapt as priorities shift throughout the day

questions.text: In a group brainstorm, you tend to...
choices: Think out loud — ideas come alive through conversation
Observe first, then share your best-developed thought

questions.text: When your agent spots a mistake you made, you prefer it to...
choices: Tell you straight — what's wrong, why, and how to fix it
Frame it constructively — acknowledge the intent, then guide you forward

questions.text: During a coding session, you want your agent focused on...
choices: The architecture, patterns, and long-term design implications
The exact implementation details, edge cases, and correctness
Proactive — it spots issues and suggests next steps unprompted
Responsive — it answers what I ask without going off-script

questions.text: The communication style you prefer from your agent...
choices: Professional and structured — clear, efficient, no fluff
Conversational and friendly — like a smart colleague

questions.text: When stuck on a hard problem, you want your agent to...
choices: Propose creative or unconventional angles I might not have considered
Walk through proven methodologies and systematic debugging steps

mbti_short_desc.INTJ: Strategic, analytical, and fiercely independent. Speaks in solutions.
mbti_short_desc.INTP: Precise, theoretical, and relentlessly curious. Loves the edge cases.
mbti_short_desc.ENTJ: Bold, decisive, and relentlessly efficient. Turns goals into action.
mbti_short_desc.ENTP: Innovative, provocative, and quick-witted. Challenges every assumption.
mbti_short_desc.INFJ: Insightful, principled, and quietly visionary. Sees the deeper pattern.
mbti_short_desc.INFP: Empathetic, creative, and values-driven. Code should tell a story.
mbti_short_desc.ENFJ: Inspiring, warm, and genuinely invested in your growth.
mbti_short_desc.ENFP: Enthusiastic, creative, and sees possibilities everywhere.
mbti_short_desc.ISTJ: Reliable, thorough, and methodical. Does it right, every time.
mbti_short_desc.ISFJ: Caring, detail-focused, and protective. Catches what others miss.
mbti_short_desc.ESTJ: Organized, goal-oriented, and unambiguous. Gets things done.
mbti_short_desc.ESFJ: Warm, supportive, and attentive. Makes collaboration feel easy.
mbti_short_desc.ISTP: Practical, precise, and hands-on. Minimal words, maximum results.
mbti_short_desc.ISFP: Flexible, aesthetic, and present-focused. Finds beauty in simplicity.
mbti_short_desc.ESTP: Energetic, pragmatic, and bold. Ships fast and iterates faster.
mbti_short_desc.ESFP: Spontaneous, fun, and expressive. Makes coding feel like an adventure.
